packages.name: celero
packages.description: Celero is a C++ micro-benchmarking library to measure the performance of C++ code.
packages.comment: The installed Celero library. Celero has no third-party runtime dependencies; only the operating-system libraries listed in this document are required at link and run time. gtest is intentionally absent because it is test-only and never enters the installed artifact -- see the source-distribution SBOM for the full build-time inventory.

packages.name: powrprof
packages.comment: Windows Power Profile API import library, linked via SYSLIBS in CMakeLists.txt. <powrprof.h> is included by src/Utilities.cpp; no power-management entry point is currently called, so this link may be vestigial. Supplied by the operating system; not distributed with Celero.

packages.name: psapi
packages.comment: Windows Process Status API import library, linked via SYSLIBS in CMakeLists.txt. Used by src/Memory.cpp via GetProcessMemoryInfo() to sample process memory counters. Supplied by the operating system; not distributed with Celero.
